# Hubbo

> A Hubbo hub's local REST API. Hubbo is a universal-remote hub that runs activities across TVs, receivers, streamers and Home Assistant. Read the agent guide first: it covers everyday tasks. Use the OpenAPI spec only to look up an exact schema or error.

- [Agent guide (start here)](/api/v1/agent.md): devices, activities and buttons, with worked examples
- [OpenAPI spec (reference; large)](/api/v1/openapi.json): the full contract
